_readme: CANONICAL repo allowlist for the Ever self-hosted star-history instance.
This ONE file drives three things, so edit it here and nowhere else:
1. backend/allowlist.ts  - which repos /svg will answer for, per Host header
2. ever/seed-gh-data.mjs - the leaderboard + autocomplete data baked into the UI
3. the README badges in each product repo
Matching is case-insensitive. 'owner/*' wildcards are supported.
A Host not listed under 'hosts' falls back to 'default'. 'default' is empty,
so the service FAILS CLOSED: an unknown Host answers nothing.
Changing this file requires an image rebuild (the UI data is baked at build time).
For an emergency runtime-only override, set ALLOWLIST_FILE to a mounted ConfigMap.
